description: This file defines a PHP interface named CacheInterface within the Aws namespace, representing a simple cache mechanism with methods to get, set, and remove cache items.

classes.name: CacheInterface
classes.description: An interface representing a simple cache with methods for retrieving, storing, and removing cache items.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve a cache item by key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Store a cache item with a specified key, value, and TTL (time to live).

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Remove a cache item by key.
